claims.evidence: Witness report only shows PS4/DUALSHOCK 4 controller box packaging; no console model/version (e.g., CUH number) or “slim” details are shown.
No console screen, storage/menu, or game library is shown in the witness report.

claims.claim: comes with two brand new pads
claims.evidence: Witness report shows two DualShock 4 controller boxes, but does not confirm the controllers inside are brand new or even included.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No evidence of opening/repair status is shown; only packaging is described.
No testing footage or port checks are shown.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: Witness report mentions controller box branding but does not show receipt or confirm authenticity/originality.

risks.risk: The listing may be for controller boxes/packaging rather than working controllers and/or the console; controllers may be missing or not included.
risks.proof: A clear video showing the actual items out of the boxes (controllers in hand) plus a count of items included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed/possibly incomplete bundle (controllers and console not guaranteed), worst-case for buyer.

risks.risk: Controllers may have faults (stick drift, unresponsive buttons, worn analogs) even if boxes are present.
risks.proof: A short clip of each controller connected to a PS4 showing full button presses and analog stick movement with no drift.

risks.risk: Authenticity risk: controllers/console could be counterfeit or refurbished parts despite “brand new/original” claims.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of controller serial/model markings and ports, plus matching labels on the console packaging/console body.

risks.risk: Console model/version and condition are unknown (PS4 slim vs other, CUH number, storage size, and whether it powers on).
risks.proof: A power-on clip showing the PS4 boot screen and system settings page (model/CUH and storage).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case unknown model/unknown storage/untested condition.

risks.risk: “Hacked with games installed” may be false; games could be missing, or console could be banned/unstable.
risks.proof: A screen recording showing the installed games library and system status (no error screens), plus confirmation of account/network status if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console without confirmed installed games.

risks.risk: Accessories may be missing (HDMI, power cable, headset jack cover, manuals), affecting buyer value.
risks.proof: A laid-out photo/video of every included accessory with a checklist (power/HDMI/cables/manuals).

proof_requests: Send clear photos/video of the actual PS4 console (front/back/side) showing the model/version label (CUH) and storage info.
Send a power-on video showing the boot screen and the system settings page (model/CUH and storage).
Show the installed games library on-screen (screen recording) to confirm “games installed”.
Show both controllers out of the boxes, with close-ups of serial/model markings and ports.
Provide a quick test clip for each controller: button responsiveness and analog stick movement (no drift).
Lay out and photograph every included accessory (power cable, HDMI, manuals, any covers) and confirm the UK receipt if it exists.
response.reason: The witness report only supports that PS4 DualShock 4 controller packaging exists; it does not verify the console model/condition, whether games are installed, or whether the controllers are included and working. Without these proof points, a worst-case price would be unreliable.
